title: Fix canonical component hashing in historical Live Net recalculation
author: agent:/root

scope.goal: Fix the verified historical Live candidate component-hash mismatch that prevents Net accounting from being saved, without changing financial rules or scheduling; deliver the focused correction and regression verification on master for user deployment.
inScope: LoadHistoricalGrossNetParityPageLiveTargetsAsync in PostgresAppRepository.HistoricalGrossNetParity.cs: derive Live ComponentHash from the same canonical ProvedComponents representation used by ValidateHistoricalGrossNetParityTargetBindingAsync, and derive BindingHash from that corrected component hash.

Keep the already-associated VenueReported payload and its evidence-reference SHA-256 independently bound to the original normalized payload, rather than replacing that evidence hash with the empty component-graph hash.

The existing common historical Live accounting path, including priority strategy b7c50005-0000-4000-8079-000000000150 / ETH Up or Down 5m Up 50 bps Instant and other already-eligible Live targets processed later by the unchanged worker.

Focused regression tests of the actual PostgreSQL candidate-load, preparation, Live accounting and existing reconciliation path; preservation, tamper/CAS rejection and retry-idempotence checks on synthetic fixtures only.

A concise README note in the existing historical-parity section, required context/history bookkeeping, contract validation, affected service build, focused tests, independent semantic review and scoped Git delivery on master.
outOfScope: Any change to Fee = ROUND_AWAY_8(B * 0.0333), Net = Gross - Fee, the 3.33-percentage-point ROI fallback, exact-fee precedence, donor removal, Gross amounts or ROI bases.

Any change to historical eligibility, the strict 2026-08-10T00:00:00Z originating-entry cutoff, priority strategy identity, descending current-Gross ordering, strategy completion gates, batch sizes, timeouts, foreground yielding, retry scheduling or accounting/reconciliation transaction semantics.

Any change to ordinary new Paper/Live accounting, execution, orders, fills, settlements, strategy settings, counters, schemas, migrations, indexes, APIs, on-chain fee matching or Paper target hash construction.

Rewriting completed historical fee/Net values, resetting audits or checkpoints, manually recalculating Production rows, running donor calculations, or adding a new backfill/diagnostic framework or new logging behavior.
Production mutations, backups, deployment, service stop/restart, configuration changes or live-trading actions. The user deploys the finished service; the existing worker then resumes automatically.
Any edits or commits belonging to the concurrent LossDiff Positive Progress task. No new branch, worktree, stash, reset or unrelated cleanup.
scope.periodOrFilter: Existing historical Gross-counted settled Live contributions with a proved originating entry strictly before 2026-08-10T00:00:00Z UTC. Verified priority preview at 2026-09-02T20:47:29.175405Z: 405 historical Live targets, 403 LegacyUnknown/Net-missing and 2 exact/Net-complete, no Live parity audit and ownership None; service Running with fresh heartbeat and zero waiting locks. This is not an assertion of the entire multi-strategy backlog count.
scope.firstVerification: Recheck the current master/worktree and exact reader-to-validator call path, preserve concurrent unrelated edits, and compare a forced-read-only Production target preview with the prior evidence before product edits. Reproduce the current mismatch through a synthetic PostgreSQL regression before applying the source correction.

requirements.text: Correct the identified historical Live component-hash incompatibility so unchanged eligible Live targets can pass existing binding validation and persist their existing-policy Net accounting.
acceptanceCriteria: Every Live snapshot produced by the affected reader has ComponentHash equal to HistoricalGrossNetParityComponentGraphV1.ComputeComponentHash(snapshot.ProvedComponents), including the empty component list; its BindingHash uses that same value.

VenueReported component payload and exact evidence-reference hash remain a SHA-256 binding to the original normalized venue evidence payload; changing the target component hash does not discard or substitute venue evidence identity.

A synthetic pre-cutoff settled LegacyUnknown Live order with balance_effect_applied=true, ownership None and no prior audit is loaded through the real candidate page and preparer, then successfully applies the unchanged direct-fixed accounting decision without donor candidates. Stored fee, Net, baseline/audit and ordered balance reconciliation match the existing policy.

The regression fails against the original source with the observed hash conflict and passes after the focused correction. Repeating completed accounting/reconciliation does not duplicate audit decisions or financial balance effects.

Already exact Live fees and correct Net are preserved; post-cutoff fixtures are excluded; tampered binding or a concurrent row-version change still fails closed without an accounting write. Existing focused Paper and strategy-order tests continue to pass.

Only synthetic disposable data is written.

The service project builds; focused tests execute successfully on isolated data; an independent reviewer compares the original prompts, approved contract, exact task diff and verification evidence and returns pass without open findings.
